review_candidates.description: Vann Data is an established managed IT services provider hiring a Tier 2+ IT support engineer who can support Daytona Beach and surrounding areas. You take the escalations, drive to a client site when hands are needed, and work on projects and stack builds alongside our senior engineers. Escalations remain the top priority, especially when the queue is busy. Between escalations, you will implement our stack onsite, document how we and our clients work, and partner with our AI engineering team to improve internal and client operations. This hands-on technical role offers a clear path for those who earn it. We are in the middle of a deliberate shift. Vann Data is helping clients use AI strategically, and we are rebuilding our own service desk around AI and automation. That means change is constant here. If you see that as an opportunity rather than a disruption, you will fit right in. Core Technical Requirements ·         Microsoft 365 and Entra ID (Azure AD): user and group administration, license assignment, MFA enrollment and resets, password and lockout resolution. ·         Active Directory: creating and disabling users, group membership, share and NTFS permissions, drive mapping. ·         Outlook and Exchange Online: client and profile issues, shared mailboxes, calendar permissions, basic mail delivery troubleshooting. ·         Email security: spam and phishing triage, quarantine review and release, allow and block list requests. ·         Windows endpoints: setup and deployment, driver and firmware updates, performance and application troubleshooting. ·         Printers, scanners and multifunction devices: driver installation, scan-to-folder and scan-to-email configuration. ·         Networking (strong working knowledge required): TCP/IP, DNS, routing, DHCP, VLANs, switching basics, the OSI model, and structured troubleshooting from endpoint to gateway. ·         Wireless: access point, controllers, and SSID configuration, authentication failures, coverage, interference and roaming issues. ·         Remote access: VPN client setup, MFA-protected remote sessions, and connectivity triage. ·         Security fundamentals: least privilege/zero trust mindset, phishing recognition, and knowing when to escalate a possible incident rather than quietly resolve it. Familiarity with EDR/ITDR. ·         Firewalls: configuration and management experience, including rule changes and troubleshooting from the LAN side out. AI Is Part of the Job, Not a Side Project ·        Use AI assistants daily to research errors, draft clear resolution notes, and turn fixes into knowledge base articles. ·        Help clients move from AI curiosity to AI strategy: where it fits their business, where it does not, and how to adopt it safely. ·        Help shape and test how we apply AI internally, from triage and documentation to reporting and client communication. The Work: Escalations, Projects and AI Delivery ·        Act as an escalation point for the help desk: work the hard tickets to root cause and document fixes the team can reuse. ·        Implement our standard technology stack for new and existing clients, pairing with a senior engineer on larger builds. ·        Work alongside our AI engineering organization on client AI deployments: configuring assistants and agents against client systems and helping move pilots into production. ·        Contribute to client AI readiness assessments and help turn findings into a roadmap. ·        Help deploy AI security controls: data loss prevention and sensitivity labeling, tenant-level AI usage policies, shadow-AI discovery, and guardrails for approved tools. Experience We Are Looking For ·        Three to five years in an MSP, managed services, or multi-client IT environment. ·        Hands-on work with a managed security stack: identity, endpoint management, email security, backup, network or EDR/ITDR. ·        Working familiarity with Intune, Windows Autopilot or Group Policy. ·        Some PowerShell/PHP: scripts you have written or adapted and used. ·        Client-facing comfort: you can explain a technical problem to a business owner without jargon. ·        Hands-on AI experience and the drive to use it to improve your work and our processes. ·        Degree or coursework in Information Technology, AI, Computer Science or Cybersecurity, or equivalent hands-on experience. ·        CompTIA Network+ or Security+, or Microsoft MS-102, AZ-104 or comparable, held now or with a stated plan to earn them. Our Core Values ·         Integrity – Do the right thing. ·         Accountability – Own the outcome. ·         Innovation – Collaboration & Curiosity. ·         Connection – Clients, communities, & colleagues. ·         Passion – Bringing light to the work we do. Serving Our Clients and Their Communities ·        Learn each client’s business well enough to see what technology we should fix next and bring the idea forward instead of waiting to be asked. ·        Treat a ticket as part of a relationship, not a transaction. Clients remember how you left them, not only whether the issue closed. ·        Look for ways to deepen what we do for a client: a security gap worth closing, a manual process worth automating, an aging system worth planning around. ·        Remember who is downstream. The nonprofits, schools, medical practices and local businesses we support serve the Daytona Beach community, and their uptime is the community’s uptime. Who Succeeds Here ·        Strong work ethic and self-motivated: you drive tickets to closure without being chased. ·        Comfortable working across both worlds in the same week: an escalated outage in the morning, a client AI readiness session in the afternoon. ·        Bring real curiosity and drive about applying AI to streamline the service desk: cutting handle time, sharpening triage, and improving how the whole queue performs, not just your own tickets. ·        You write clearly to non-technical people and stay calm on the phone under pressure. ·        You care about the client on the other end of the ticket, and about the community that client serves. ·        You want to be measured on response time, first-touch resolution, and what you learned this quarter. ·        You reach for AI as a first instinct, whether to research an unfamiliar error, sanity-check a fix, or draft the documentation, and you know when the answer needs a human check before it goes to a client. ·        You embrace change. We are transforming Vann Data into an AI-driven MSP powered by automation, best-of-breed solutions and great people, and you want to help build it rather than watch it happen. Schedule, Travel and Compensation ·        Core hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern, Monday through Friday. ·        Participation in an after-hours on-call rotation shared across the team, with on-call hours paid at overtime rates. ·        A valid driver’s license is required, since the role includes travel to client sites. ·        Physical requirements: lift and carry equipment up to 50 lbs; bend, kneel and crawl to reach equipment under desks and in tight spaces; climb ladders to reach access points and ceiling runs; and sit or stand for extended periods. ·        Employment is contingent on a successful background check and drug screen. ·        Compensation rate depends on experience. You are eligible to use PTO after 90 days of employment. ·        Six paid holidays plus two bonus days. ·        401(k) with company match. ·        Paid training and certifications. ·        Cell phone reimbursement.
